idea: Everyone has a visible number or meter above their head (lies told, times they cried, money in the bank, days left, how much they love you); the main kid judges people by it until a twist shows what the number really hides.
title_pattern: In this world everyone can see your lies

idea: A childhood saying or superstition is literally true (step on a crack breaks your mom's back, if you make a face it stays that way, swallowing gum grows a tree); a funny town-wide consequence and a competition or crisis where the kid uses the rule to win.
title_pattern: Step On A Crack Break Your Moms BACK...

idea: A strange rule about families (siblings swap bodies when they fight, parents shrink when you lie to them, your pet speaks for one day a year); a sibling or parent story with a heartfelt or hilarious payoff.
title_pattern: In this world siblings swap bodies when they fight

idea: A strange rule at school (your grade shows on your shirt, the class clown gets superpowers, homework comes alive if you skip it); an underdog kid story with a twist.
title_pattern: In this world your grades show on your forehead

idea: A strange rule about bodies or senses (you shrink every time you lie, your hair color shows your mood, you can hear what people think about you once a day); funny examples then an emotional twist.
title_pattern: In this world lying makes you shorter

idea: The rule comes from a trending Roblox game, especially Steal An Egg (if someone steals your egg you lose a memory, the rarer your egg the more powerful you are), or Throw Food For Animals; a kid story inside that world with a twist.
title_pattern: In this world your egg decides your life

idea: Wishes, money or popularity have a strange price (every wish costs one friend, every Robux you spend ages you a day); greed then a twist and a smart ending.
title_pattern: In this world every wish costs you a friend
